_doc.checkEdgeCoverage: Counts non-white pixels in the margin band. This detects app chrome (cookie banner, sidebar, sticky header) leaking into a PDF the app renders from a live page. It presumes a white page with clear margins, so it is meaningless for a designed full-bleed asset and MUST be set false for one — otherwise it reports ~100% on every page forever and says nothing about quality.
_doc.minImageDpi: Effective placed resolution (image pixels / placed size), as reported by `pdfimages -list`. 150 is the print bar; a screen-only deliverable can justify less, but lower it deliberately and record why.

company-profile._note: Static designer-authored brochure (pdf-lib/Ghostscript), served from public/documents — not rendered by the app. Every page is full-bleed on the champagne brand ground (#FEF5E7), so there is no margin band to police: measured edge coverage is 99.19-100% on all 18 pages by design. Page count and image DPI are the checks that carry meaning here.
